title: design-kb: component palette
description: Suitability metadata per component/extension: enough that 'which component fits this lesson' is answerable from the file. Points to specs; never duplicates them.

build.description: Build state of the underlying component. Omitted = available (built/usable). 'pending' = designed into the model but the component is not currently built (keep the design; do not author with it yet). 'deprecated' = superseded; retained for provenance, not for new authoring.

shape.description: Teaching shape it suits, e.g. sequential-reveal, two-versions-comparison, retrieval-practice, paired-disclosure.

register.description: Pedagogical register in that use; where register lives in instruction text not config (FC-2 pattern), say so.

accessibility.description: One-line a11y character (keyboard/SR model); spec holds detail.

configNotes.description: Quirks a proposal must know, e.g. passreveal _assessmentIds[] vs resultsdebrief _assessmentId inconsistency; flipcard index-keyed _items reorder hazard.
